zurich.summary: Zurich is a Swiss composite insurer writing property, casualty and life cover for retail and commercial customers. It operates in most major markets and sells through brokers, banks and its own digital channels.

insurancedekho.summary: InsuranceDekho is an Indian insurtech that sells motor, health and life policies online and through a network of local advisers. It distributes as a licensed broker rather than underwriting risk itself.

corgi.summary: Corgi is an AI-powered insurtech that underwrites commercial insurance for startups and small businesses through a full-stack digital platform. It positions itself as a technology-native alternative to traditional commercial carriers.

willis-towers-watson.summary: Willis Towers Watson is a global insurance broker and professional services firm serving corporate clients. It advises on risk management, reinsurance broking, employee benefits and pensions across industries including technology and data centres.

turtlemint.summary: Turtlemint is an Indian insurtech that distributes insurance through a network of independent advisers and its own digital platform. It sells motor, health and life policies rather than underwriting them.

lemonade.summary: Lemonade is a US insurance company that uses AI and behavioral economics to sell renters, home, pet, life and car insurance through an app. It also offers usage-based coverage for autonomous Tesla driving.

ondo-insurtech.summary: Ondo InsurTech is a UK company that makes the LeakBot water-leak detection device sold to home insurers to prevent escape-of-water claims. Its shares trade on London's AIM market.

chubb.summary: Chubb is a global property and casualty insurer writing commercial and personal lines alongside a large accident and health book. It is listed in New York and underwrites in most major markets.

bolttech.summary: bolttech is a Singapore-based insurtech running an exchange that connects insurers, distributors and customers for embedded protection. It sells device, gadget and motor cover through telcos, banks and retailers.

root.summary: Root is a US insurtech that underwrites car insurance priced on driving behaviour measured through a smartphone app. It sells direct and through embedded partnerships with car retailers and finance apps.

ethos.summary: Ethos is a US insurtech selling term and whole life insurance online, using data-driven underwriting in place of medical exams. It works with established carriers rather than underwriting on its own paper.

cover-genius.summary: Cover Genius is an insurtech that provides embedded insurance and warranty cover through travel, e-commerce and fintech platforms. It sells inside partner checkouts rather than direct to consumers.

irdai.summary: IRDAI is the statutory regulator of the insurance industry in India, licensing insurers and intermediaries and setting conduct and solvency rules. It also runs sector-wide digital infrastructure programmes.

igloo.summary: Igloo is a Singapore-based insurtech selling microinsurance and embedded cover across South-East Asia through telcos, retailers and platforms. It acts as a distributor and technology provider, not an insurer.

aon.summary: Aon is a global professional services firm that brokers insurance and reinsurance and advises clients on risk and human capital. It also builds risk-analytics and AI tools for clients managing emerging exposures such as cyber and climate risk.

guidewire.summary: Guidewire is a software company selling core policy, billing and claims systems to property and casualty insurers. Its products are delivered as cloud services alongside a partner programme for integrations.

plum.summary: Plum is an Indian insurtech that sells group health insurance and employee benefits to companies rather than to individuals. It bundles claims handling and primary care services alongside the cover.

openai.summary: OpenAI is an artificial intelligence research and product company. It appears in insurance coverage because insurers and comparison sites now distribute quotes and handle service inside its ChatGPT platform.

policystreet.summary: PolicyStreet is a Malaysian insurtech selling embedded and direct insurance across South-East Asia and Australia. It runs a licensed underwriting arm as well as distribution, a model it calls full-stack.

kayna.summary: Kayna is an Irish insurtech that embeds small-business insurance inside the vertical software platforms those businesses already use. It works with brokers and carriers rather than carrying risk itself.

naicom.summary: NAICOM is the National Insurance Commission, the statutory regulator of Nigeria's insurance industry. It licenses insurers, brokers and insurtechs and sets the market's conduct and capital rules.

allianz.summary: Allianz is a German insurance and asset management group writing property, casualty, life and health business worldwide. It also runs a corporate venture arm that invests in insurtechs.

jazzworld.summary: JazzWorld is the digital services platform of Pakistani mobile operator Jazz, distributing insurance and other products to its subscribers. It has since moved into insurance underwriting itself.

alan.summary: Alan is a French health insurance company that sells group medical cover to employers and runs its own digital care platform. It holds an insurance licence and underwrites rather than only distributing.

1life.summary: 1Life is a South African direct life insurer selling funeral, life and disability cover straight to consumers rather than through brokers. It distributes by phone and digital channels, including messaging apps.

aig.summary: AIG is a US-based global insurer writing commercial property, casualty and specialty lines for corporate and institutional clients.

apollo-global-management.summary: Apollo Global Management is a US alternative asset manager investing in credit, private equity and real assets. Its retirement services arm writes annuities, which is why it appears in insurance coverage.

balcia.summary: Balcia is a Latvian non-life insurer selling motor, property and travel cover across the Baltics and several other European markets.

blinkit.summary: Blinkit is an Indian quick-commerce company delivering groceries and household goods on demand. It is not an insurance business, and appears here through coverage of delivery-linked and embedded cover.

cambridge-mobile-telematics.summary: Cambridge Mobile Telematics is a US telematics company whose smartphone-based driving data is used by insurers for usage-based motor pricing and claims.

cimarron-underwriters.summary: Cimarron Underwriters is a US managing general agent whose licences span the US states, providing regulated underwriting capacity to distribution partners.

coverdrone.summary: Coverdrone is a specialist intermediary arranging insurance for commercial and recreational drone operators, including liability and hull cover.

direct-asia.summary: Direct Asia is a direct-to-consumer motor insurer operating in Singapore and Thailand, selling car and motorcycle cover online and by phone rather than through agents.

elevate-specialty.summary: Elevate Specialty is a managing general agent that underwrites cyber insurance for small and medium-sized businesses, distributing through broker partners.

generali-hong-kong.summary: Generali Hong Kong is the Hong Kong operation of the Italian insurance group Generali, writing life and general insurance for local customers.

hawksoft.summary: HawkSoft is a US software company selling agency management systems to independent insurance agencies. Its product handles client records, policy servicing and workflow for small brokerages.

ibac.summary: IBAC is the Insurance Brokers Association of Canada, the national federation representing property and casualty insurance brokers. It runs industry programmes and advocates for broker distribution.

kwh-analytics.summary: kWh Analytics is a US firm providing risk data and insurance products for solar and storage projects. It arranges production-shortfall cover for renewable energy assets through carrier partners.

m-kopa.summary: M-KOPA is a pan-African financing company selling smartphones, solar systems and other assets on instalment credit. It distributes insurance alongside those products rather than underwriting it.

metlife-nepal.summary: MetLife Nepal is the Nepalese life insurance operation of the US insurer MetLife, selling individual and group life cover.

national-flood-insurance-program.summary: The National Flood Insurance Program is a US federal programme providing flood cover to homeowners and businesses through participating insurers. It depends on periodic reauthorisation by Congress.

nv-energy.summary: NV Energy is an electric and gas utility serving the state of Nevada. It appears in insurance coverage through its wildfire liability exposure and its use of self-insurance to fund that risk.

padosiagent.summary: PadosiAgent is an Indian insurtech platform that helps consumers find and verify insurance agents working in their own local area.

pints-ai.summary: Pints.ai is a technology company selling a generative-AI platform that automates document handling and back-office workflow for insurers.

raa.summary: RAA is a South Australian motoring club that also sells motor, home and travel insurance to its members. It services those policies alongside roadside assistance.

shriram-life-insurance.summary: Shriram Life Insurance is an Indian life insurer, part of the Shriram financial services group, selling protection and savings policies. It focuses on customers in smaller towns and rural markets.

steers-insurance.summary: Steers Insurance is a Canadian insurance brokerage placing personal and commercial cover for local clients.

terrafuse-ai.summary: Terrafuse AI is a US company that models physical climate risk, including wildfire, for property insurance pricing and underwriting.

tranzpay.summary: Tranzpay is a payments company providing premium collection and claims disbursement services to insurers.

vig.summary: VIG is Vienna Insurance Group, an Austrian insurer writing property, casualty and life business across central and eastern Europe.

zhibao.summary: Zhibao Technology is a Chinese insurtech that operates a digital insurance brokerage platform distributing embedded and specialty coverage such as auto, health and drone insurance. It also holds a reinsurance license in Labuan, Malaysia.

mapfre.summary: Mapfre is a Spanish multinational insurance and reinsurance group offering property, life and motor coverage across Europe and Latin America.

gallagher.summary: Gallagher is a global insurance brokerage that arranges commercial insurance, reinsurance and risk management for corporate clients. Its Gallagher Re unit also publishes widely cited research on insurtech and reinsurance market trends.

tpl-insurance.summary: TPL Insurance is a Pakistani general insurer providing motor, property and other non-life insurance products, with a growing focus on digital distribution.

heirs-insurance-group.summary: Heirs Insurance Group is a Nigerian insurance company offering general and life insurance products as part of the Heirs Holdings group of companies.

zopper.summary: Zopper is an Indian insurtech that provides embedded insurance distribution technology, letting brands and retailers sell insurance at the point of sale. It also runs an insurance broking business alongside its digital infrastructure platform.

the-hartford.summary: The Hartford is a US insurance company offering property and casualty, group benefits and mutual fund products to businesses and individuals. It runs global technology centers, including in India, to support underwriting and claims with AI.

policybazaar.summary: Policybazaar is an Indian online insurance marketplace where consumers compare and buy life, health and motor insurance policies. It is part of PB Fintech and has expanded into reinsurance broking across South Asia and the Gulf.

naked.summary: Naked is a South African insurtech that sells car and other personal insurance directly to consumers through an app, using AI to underwrite and process claims.

verisk.summary: Verisk is a US data analytics and technology company that provides risk assessment, catastrophe modeling and claims data tools to the insurance industry. It also researches emerging fraud trends, including AI-driven image manipulation in claims.

jubilee.summary: Jubilee Insurance is an East African insurance group offering life, health and general insurance products across Kenya and neighboring markets. It partners with embedded-insurance and telecom platforms to distribute cover through everyday consumer apps.

kwant.summary: Kwant is a technology platform that provides embedded insurance and compliance tracking for subcontractors and gig workforces in construction.

duck-creek.summary: Duck Creek Technologies is a US vendor of core insurance software—policy administration, billing and claims—sold as SaaS to insurers. It competes with Guidewire in the P&C core-systems market.

lic.summary: LIC (Life Insurance Corporation of India) is India's state-owned life insurer, selling life and savings policies through a nationwide agent network.

mea.summary: mea Platform is an AI-driven insurtech that sells software to insurers and reinsurers to automate underwriting and claims processes. It aims to improve combined ratios and margins for its clients.

acko.summary: Acko is an Indian digital insurer that sells motor, health and other personal insurance policies directly to consumers online.

aviva.summary: Aviva is a British multinational insurer offering life, health and general insurance plus asset management to individuals and businesses.

ominimo.summary: Ominimo is a Hungarian-Serbian insurtech that sells AI-powered car insurance directly to consumers across Central and Eastern Europe.

neuralkart.summary: NeuralKart is an Indian AI insurtech startup building software for insurance processes and industrial safety applications.

marshmallow.summary: Marshmallow is a UK insurtech that sells car insurance to migrants and drivers with thin credit files, using alternative data for pricing.

yas-digital-group.summary: YAS Digital Group is a Hong Kong insurtech that builds embedded insurance products for robotics and AI-driven devices with insurer partners.

honeycomb.summary: Honeycomb is a US insurtech that uses AI to underwrite commercial property insurance, focused on real estate risks like habitational buildings.

qover.summary: Qover is a Belgian insurtech that sells embedded insurance through banks, mobility platforms and retailers via an API rather than to consumers directly.

bestow.summary: Bestow is a Dallas-based insurtech that provides a digital life insurance platform, selling term life policies directly to consumers. It also licenses its automated underwriting technology to other insurance carriers.

safety-insurance-group.summary: Safety Insurance Group is a property and casualty insurer that sells auto and homeowners coverage in Massachusetts and other New England states.

inflection-point-ventures.summary: Inflection Point Ventures is an Indian angel investing platform that pools individual investors to fund early-stage startups. It invests across sectors, including insurtech startups building AI-driven insurance tools.

liberty-mutual.summary: Liberty Mutual is a US insurer that sells personal and commercial property and casualty coverage, including auto, home and business insurance. Its Liberty Mutual Re unit provides reinsurance to other carriers.

qumis.summary: Qumis is an insurtech that builds AI tools for commercial property and casualty insurance underwriting and coverage analysis. Its AI agents help insurance teams handle knowledge work such as policy review and coverage comparisons.

axa.summary: AXA is a French multinational insurance group that sells life, health and property and casualty coverage to individuals and businesses worldwide. It also operates asset management and digital insurance ventures in several markets.

income.summary: Income Insurance is a Singapore-based insurer that sells life, health, motor and travel coverage to individuals and businesses. It also builds digital and embedded-insurance platforms for partners across Asia.

j-d-power.summary: J.D. Power is a US market research firm that studies consumer satisfaction and shopping behavior across industries, including insurance. It publishes regular studies on auto insurance shopping and digital claims satisfaction.

infosys.summary: Infosys is an Indian IT services and consulting company that builds technology platforms for insurers and healthcare providers. It also acquires specialist consultancies to expand its insurance technology capabilities.

tesla.summary: Tesla is a US automaker that designs and manufactures electric vehicles, including models with its Full Self-Driving driver-assistance system. Insurers use Full Self-Driving data to underwrite and price auto insurance for Tesla owners.

one.summary: One Inc is a US technology vendor that provides a digital payments platform for insurance carriers. It processes premium collection and claims disbursement and partners with insurtechs to embed payments into claims workflows.

sola.summary: Sola is a US insurtech that sells parametric property insurance for weather and natural disaster risks. It pays claims automatically based on measured conditions and operates as a vertically integrated insurance carrier.

wefox.summary: wefox is a Berlin-based insurtech that sells insurance policies and increasingly operates as a managing general agent (MGA), underwriting and distributing cover through its own digital platform and partner insurers.

applied-systems.summary: Applied Systems is a US insurance technology vendor that makes cloud-based agency and broker management software used to run policy administration, rating and commission workflows.

travelers.summary: Travelers is a major US property and casualty insurer offering commercial, personal and specialty lines including auto, home, liability and surety coverage.

qic.summary: QIC (Qatar Insurance Company) is a Gulf-region insurer and reinsurer offering commercial, personal and specialty coverage, and has been expanding its digital insurance ecosystem and insurtech investments.

ergo-next-insurance.summary: ERGO NEXT Insurance is a US digital insurer for small businesses, selling commercial coverage such as general liability and workers' compensation online, and operates as part of Munich Re's ERGO group following its acquisition.

oip-insurtech.summary: OIP Insurtech provides AI and automation software for insurance carriers, MGAs and brokers, covering areas such as document intelligence, workflow diagnostics and underwriting process automation.

boxx.summary: BOXX Insurance is a Toronto-based cyber insurtech that sells cyber protection and insurance products, including its Cyberboxx policy, to individuals and small and mid-sized businesses.

fulcrum.summary: Fulcrum builds AI agent software that automates workflows for US insurance brokers, aiming to connect legacy agency systems with modern automation tools.

tiktok-shop.summary: TikTok Shop is the e-commerce marketplace built into the TikTok app, letting merchants sell products directly to users, and has begun partnering with insurers to offer embedded coverage to its sellers.

peak3.summary: Peak3 is a Singapore-based insurance technology company that provides a cloud core platform for insurers to build and launch digital insurance products across Asia.

metlife.summary: MetLife is a global insurer offering life, health and employee benefits products, and has been expanding digital distribution and claims automation through partnerships and insurtech investments.

wrisk.summary: Wrisk is a UK embedded insurance technology platform that lets brands and automakers offer motor and other insurance products directly within their own apps and services.

zinnia.summary: Zinnia is an insurance technology company that provides policy administration and distribution software for life insurance and annuity carriers. It also offers data and analytics tools built with cloud partners for the sector.

pace.summary: Pace is a US insurtech that builds AI-powered software to automate back-office and operations workflows for insurance carriers.

ebix.summary: Ebix Technologies is an insurance and financial-services software provider serving insurers and brokers in India and internationally.

neat.summary: Neat is a French insurtech that embeds insurance and assistance products into payment cards and financial services through partner distribution.

peak-xv-partners.summary: Peak XV Partners is a venture capital firm covering India and Southeast Asia, formerly known as Sequoia Capital India. It backs technology and consumer companies, including insurtechs.

koala.summary: Koala is a travel insurtech that provides travel insurance and assistance products through airline and travel-agency partnerships. It was acquired by travel-technology company CarTrawler to expand into travel insurance.

scottish-equity-partners.summary: Scottish Equity Partners is a UK growth-equity investment firm that backs technology companies, including insurtechs such as mea Platform.

nirvana.summary: Nirvana is a US insurtech that uses AI and telematics data to underwrite commercial trucking insurance for fleet operators.

renewbuy.summary: RenewBuy is an Indian insurtech that operates an online platform for comparing and buying insurance policies. It is merging with rival aggregator InsuranceDekho to form a larger insurance distribution platform in India.

coterie.summary: Coterie is a US insurtech that underwrites small-business insurance, including general and professional liability, sold through independent agents.

lockton.summary: Lockton is the largest privately held insurance brokerage, advising businesses on commercial insurance, risk management and employee benefits.

lloyd-s.summary: Lloyd's is a London-based specialist insurance and reinsurance market where member syndicates underwrite complex and specialty risks. It also runs Lloyd's Lab, an innovation programme that supports insurtech startups.

state-farm.summary: State Farm is a US mutual insurer that sells auto, home and life insurance through a network of agents. It also offers banking and financial services alongside its core personal-lines insurance business.

boltech.summary: Boltech is a Singapore-based insurtech that runs an embedded insurance exchange linking insurers with banks, telcos and other distribution partners.

sbi-life.summary: SBI Life is an Indian life insurance company that sells protection, savings and pension products through bank and agency distribution channels.

berkley.summary: Berkley is a US insurance holding company that underwrites commercial property and casualty risks through a network of specialty operating units.

ergo.summary: ERGO is a German insurer that sells life, health, property and casualty insurance to consumers and businesses across Europe and Asia.

cytora.summary: Cytora is a UK insurtech that supplies AI-driven risk data and underwriting automation software to commercial insurers.

orange-money.summary: Orange Money is a mobile money service that offers payments, transfers and embedded financial products, including insurance, across Africa and the Middle East.

outmarket-ai.summary: Outmarket AI is an insurtech that builds AI-based tools to help insurance brokers and agencies market and sell policies.

uniondigital.summary: UnionDigital is a Philippine digital bank that embeds insurance and other protection products into its digital lending and banking services.

cheche.summary: Cheche is a Chinese insurtech that runs a digital platform for auto insurance distribution, using AI tools for underwriting and vehicle pricing.

manulife.summary: Manulife is a Canadian multinational insurer that provides life and health insurance, wealth management and asset management services across Canada, Asia and the United States.

nassau-financial-group.summary: Nassau Financial Group is a US life insurance and annuity company that also runs a corporate venture program investing in insurtech startups. Its Reimagine Insurtech initiative takes equity stakes in early-stage technology companies serving the insurance industry.

digit.summary: Digit is an Indian general insurance company that sells motor, health and other property-casualty cover through a digital-first, app-based experience. It also uses AI-based tools to automate and speed up claims processing.

northwestern-mutual.summary: Northwestern Mutual is a US mutual life insurer that sells life insurance, annuities and investment products directly and through financial advisors. It also runs a corporate venture arm that invests in fintech and insurtech startups.

cbi-partnering.summary: CBI Partnering Insurtech is a Nigerian insurtech building a digital insurance ecosystem aimed at expanding retail insurance access and trust. It operates under a licence from Nigeria's insurance regulator, NAICOM.

coforge.summary: Coforge is an Indian IT services company that builds software and AI platforms for insurance carriers, including claims and underwriting tools. Its Nexa platform applies agentic AI to underwriting, claims and policy administration workflows.

apollo.summary: APOLLO is a Canadian insurtech that sells digital renters, tenant and pet insurance, often embedded into property-management and payment platforms.

visa.summary: Visa is a global payments technology company that operates a card network linking banks, merchants and consumers. It partners with insurers to embed coverage such as travel and purchase protection into card products.

icapital.summary: iCapital is a fintech platform that gives wealth managers and financial advisors technology to access and administer alternative investments. It has expanded into insurance and annuity technology through acquisitions.

hexure.summary: Hexure is an insurance and annuity technology company that sells e-application and agency management software to carriers and distributors. Its tools include illustration, licensing and new-business processing used across the annuity and life insurance industry.

gcash.summary: GCash is a Philippine mobile wallet and fintech app that lets users pay, send money, take loans and access embedded insurance coverage. Its GInsure feature offers accident, health and other cover directly within the app.

lassie.summary: Lassie is a Swedish pet insurtech that sells preventive-care-focused insurance for dogs and cats through a mobile app. The app combines coverage with health tracking and reward features for pet owners.

gigasure.summary: Gigasure is a travel insurtech that sells digital travel insurance, delivered through a mobile app and a digital insurance card. It partners with insurers to offer tailored coverage features for travelers.

roamly.summary: Roamly is a US insurtech selling specialty auto insurance for shared-economy vehicles, including carsharing, boats and motorcycles. It underwrites through Lloyd's coverholder status and uses AI-driven tools to price risk and detect fraud.

cartrawler.summary: CarTrawler is an Irish travel technology company that provides car rental and mobility booking platforms to airlines and travel agents. It has expanded into travel insurance distribution through the acquisition of an insurtech.

sure.summary: Sure is a US insurtech that provides an embedded-insurance API platform for partners to quote, bind and service policies. It has added AI agent tooling and a coverage-verification product for the property-management industry.

next-insurance.summary: Next Insurance is a US insurtech that sells small-business insurance, such as general liability and workers' compensation, directly online. It underwrites policies for sole proprietors and small businesses across industries such as contracting, retail and personal training.

beams-fintech-fund.summary: Beams Fintech Fund is a venture capital fund that invests in fintech and insurtech startups across Asia.

mitsubishi-ufj.summary: Mitsubishi UFJ is a Japanese banking group offering retail, corporate and investment banking, trust and securities services worldwide.

arch.summary: Arch Capital Group is a Bermuda-based insurer that underwrites property-casualty, mortgage and specialty insurance risks worldwide. It also writes reinsurance business alongside its primary insurance operations.

uinsure.summary: Uinsure is a UK insurtech that provides a digital platform for mortgage brokers, banks and other intermediaries to quote and sell home insurance. It works with banks and building societies to embed insurance quotes into their customer channels.

natwest.summary: NatWest is a major UK retail and commercial bank offering personal banking, mortgages and business financial services. It distributes insurance products such as home cover through partnerships with insurtech providers.

instanda.summary: INSTANDA is a UK-based insurance technology vendor that provides a no-code platform for insurers, MGAs and brokers to build and launch policy products. It integrates with other software systems to support underwriting, billing and claims workflows.

kin.summary: Kin is a US insurtech that sells homeowners insurance directly to consumers, focusing on coastal and climate-exposed markets like Florida and California. It underwrites policies covering wildfire, flood and other catastrophe risks that many traditional insurers avoid in these regions.

guardian.summary: Guardian Life is a US mutual insurer that sells life, disability and dental insurance, primarily through employer-sponsored group benefits plans. It also offers individual life insurance and financial products directly to consumers.

mckinsey.summary: McKinsey & Company is a global management consulting firm that advises insurers and reinsurers on strategy, technology and AI adoption.

iag.summary: IAG (Insurance Australia Group) is an Australian general insurer underwriting home, motor and business insurance across Australia and New Zealand. Its Firemark Ventures arm invests in insurtech and other startups.

shepherd.summary: Shepherd is a US insurtech that provides commercial insurance for construction projects, including data center and AI infrastructure builds.

kyobo-lifeplanet.summary: Kyobo Lifeplanet is a South Korean digital life insurer that sells life insurance policies directly to consumers online. It operates as part of the Kyobo Life Insurance group.

meico.summary: MEICO is a Jordanian insurer that underwrites general and life insurance and partners with telecom firms to distribute cover digitally.

britam.summary: Britam is a Kenya-based financial services group that underwrites life, health and general insurance across East Africa. It also runs asset management and a venture capital arm that backs startups.

airtel-money.summary: Airtel Money is the mobile money service of telecom operator Airtel Africa, used for transfers and payments across African markets. It increasingly partners with insurers to distribute cover to its users.

genki.summary: Genki is an insurtech that builds AI-powered claims software for insurers. It has grown through acquisitions of claims technology startups.

wave-claims.summary: Wave Claims is an insurtech that builds AI-powered claims processing software, including its Claim OS platform, for insurers and adjusters.

shopee.summary: Shopee is a Southeast Asian e-commerce platform that partners with insurers to embed insurance products into its shopping app. Partners include general and Shariah-compliant takaful insurers across the region.

bamboo-insurance.summary: Bamboo Insurance is a US insurtech MGA that underwrites homeowners insurance in wildfire-prone California, offering admitted capacity products. It also partners on wildfire prevention technology for policyholders.

baldwin-insurance-group.summary: Baldwin Insurance Group is a US insurance distribution company operating retail and wholesale brokerage and underwriting businesses. It trades publicly and grows through acquisitions of specialty agencies and insurtechs.

easypaisa.summary: easypaisa is a Pakistani mobile wallet and digital financial services platform for payments, transfers and bill pay. It also offers access to insurance products through a digital marketplace built into the app.

efu-life.summary: EFU Life Assurance is a Pakistani life insurance company offering individual and group life, health and Takaful savings products. It distributes policies through both traditional agency channels and digital partnerships.

ing.summary: ING is a Dutch multinational bank providing retail and wholesale banking, savings and lending services across Europe and beyond. It also distributes insurance and protection products through partnerships with insurtechs.

majesco.summary: Majesco is a US insurance technology vendor that provides cloud-based core administration, billing and claims software for life, annuity, and property and casualty insurers.

embed-financial.summary: Embed Financial Group is a Singapore-based fintech that provides an embedded insurance distribution platform. It lets businesses sell insurance products alongside their own, integrated into their existing customer journeys.

tokio-marine.summary: Tokio Marine is a Japanese insurance group offering property & casualty and life insurance and reinsurance worldwide. It also invests in and partners with insurtech companies to expand digital distribution.

ageas-uk.summary: Ageas UK is the British arm of the Ageas insurance group, underwriting personal lines cover such as motor and home insurance. It distributes policies through brokers, affinity partners and embedded insurance schemes.

turaco.summary: Turaco is a Kenya-based insurtech that designs and distributes affordable micro-insurance products for underserved consumers across Africa. It often partners with microfinance institutions and mobile platforms to reach customers.

byd.summary: BYD is a Chinese manufacturer of electric vehicles and batteries sold in markets worldwide. For its vehicles it also arranges embedded motor insurance through partnerships with insurers and insurtechs.

wipro.summary: Wipro is an Indian multinational IT services and consulting company serving clients across industries. It provides technology, digital transformation and application development services, including for insurers.

ageas-federal-life.summary: Ageas Federal Life Insurance is an Indian life insurer, a joint venture between Belgium's Ageas and Federal Bank. It distributes policies mainly through bancassurance and digital partner channels.

tuio.summary: Tuio is a Spanish insurtech that provides a digital platform for insurance distribution and agency management. It works with brokers and agents to digitize policy sales and customer service.

markel.summary: Markel is a US specialty insurer and reinsurer that underwrites niche commercial risks and also runs an investment holding business.

hippo.summary: Hippo is a US insurtech that sells homeowners insurance using technology-driven underwriting and smart-home risk prevention tools.

zywave.summary: Zywave is a technology vendor that sells software insurance brokers use for client management, analytics and sales enablement. Its tools include AI-driven agents and broker-facing content libraries.

swiss-re.summary: Swiss Re is a Swiss reinsurer that provides property, casualty, life and health reinsurance along with risk, capital management and data-driven advisory services to insurers worldwide.

matic.summary: Matic is a US insurtech that runs an embedded insurance marketplace, letting mortgage lenders and homeowners compare and buy home and auto insurance policies from partner carriers.

futureproof.summary: FutureProof is a US insurtech that uses AI-driven risk models to underwrite property insurance, focusing on catastrophe-exposed homes, condos and rental properties.

hub-international.summary: Hub International is a global insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on commercial, personal and employee benefits insurance and risk management.

admiral.summary: Admiral Group is a UK insurer best known for car insurance, also selling home, van, travel and other personal lines across the UK and parts of Europe.

msig-asia.summary: MSIG Asia is the Asian regional arm of Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Group, selling general insurance across Asian markets. It works with insurtech partners to distribute motor, travel and other policies through digital platforms.

singlife.summary: Singlife is a Singapore-based digital life and health insurer that sells policies directly to consumers and through bank and e-wallet partnerships.

tune-protect.summary: Tune Protect is a Malaysia-based insurtech that underwrites and distributes travel and motor insurance. It increasingly embeds cover into partner platforms such as airlines and solar installers.

loxa.summary: Loxa is a UK insurtech that provides product protection and extended warranty insurance for retailers and their customers.

gen-digital.summary: Gen Digital is a US consumer cybersecurity and digital safety company known for brands including Norton, Avast and LifeLock. It has expanded into AI-powered insurance shopping tools through acquisitions such as Trellis.

shory.summary: Shory is a UAE-based insurtech that sells car and other vehicle insurance online using AI-driven quoting. It integrates with government digital platforms to offer paperless policies.

acrisure.summary: Acrisure is a US insurance brokerage and fintech that distributes commercial and personal insurance through a network of agencies. It uses an AI-driven platform and has grown rapidly through acquisitions.

sequoia.summary: Sequoia is a US venture capital firm that invests in technology companies, including insurtech and AI-driven insurance startups.

anzen.summary: Anzen is a US insurtech that built an AI-driven platform for underwriting and distributing insurance coverage as a managing general agent.

aub.summary: AUB Group is an Australian insurance broking network that owns and partners with agencies across Australia, New Zealand and the UK. It distributes commercial and personal insurance through its network.

bjak.summary: Bjak is a Malaysian insurtech that operates an online platform for comparing and buying insurance policies. It partners with multiple insurers to sell motor and other cover.

bpi-aia.summary: BPI AIA is a Philippine life insurer formed as a joint venture between BPI and AIA Group. It sells life, health and protection products to retail customers through bank branches and digital channels in the Philippines.

pibit-ai.summary: Pibit.AI is an Indian insurtech that builds AI software to automate underwriting document review for insurers and MGAs. Its platform extracts and analyzes data from submissions to speed up commercial underwriting decisions.

generali.summary: Generali is an Italian multinational insurance group offering life, health and property-casualty insurance worldwide. It also runs asset management operations and partners with governments and development agencies on inclusive insurance programs in emerging markets.

exzeo.summary: Exzeo is an insurance technology company that provides software and technology infrastructure to property and casualty insurers. It was spun out from an insurance carrier as an independent business ahead of a US stock listing.

claimsorted.summary: ClaimSorted is a London-based insurtech that provides an AI-powered platform for processing insurance claims. Its software automates claims intake, assessment and settlement for insurers and claims handlers.

furtherai.summary: FurtherAI is a technology company that builds an AI-powered workspace to automate insurance workflows. Its software handles tasks such as underwriting and account servicing for commercial insurance carriers and brokers to reduce manual work.

inclined.summary: Inclined is a life insurtech that provides a platform for policyholders to access liquidity from their whole life insurance policies. It offers policy-secured lending and other liquidity options typically available only to wealthy clients.

laka.summary: Laka is a London-based insurer that provides collective, usage-based insurance for cyclists and bike retailers across Europe. It covers bicycles and e-bikes for individual riders as well as fleets sold through bike shops and manufacturers.

ledgebrook.summary: Ledgebrook is a US insurtech that operates as an excess and surplus lines managing general agent for commercial insurance. It underwrites specialty commercial risks and distributes policies through wholesale brokers.

bnp-paribas-cardif.summary: BNP Paribas Cardif is the insurance arm of French bank BNP Paribas, selling life and health insurance through bank partnerships. It operates a bancassurance model, distributing property, creditor and other insurance products via banks and retail partners across multiple countries.

third-wave-insurance.summary: Third Wave Insurance is a US insurance brokerage platform that acquires and consolidates independent insurance and advisory agencies. It offers commercial property and casualty coverage, employee benefits, self-funded healthcare administration and wealth management services through its agencies.

vitech.summary: Vitech is a software provider that supplies technology platforms for retirement, pension, and life and annuity insurance administration. It serves insurers, pension funds, and benefits administrators.

cfc.summary: CFC is a London-based specialty insurer and managing general agent that underwrites cyber, technology, and media insurance for businesses worldwide. It also develops proprietary risk-assessment and underwriting technology.

utica-national.summary: Utica National is a US regional insurer that provides home, auto, and business insurance coverage through a network of independent agents.

cowbell.summary: Cowbell is an insurtech that provides cyber insurance and risk assessment tools for small and medium-sized businesses, using AI-driven underwriting.

takaful-oman.summary: Takaful Oman is an Omani Islamic insurance company that provides Sharia-compliant takaful insurance products to individuals and businesses in Oman.

world-insurance-associates.summary: World Insurance Associates is a US insurance brokerage that sells commercial and personal lines coverage through acquired local agencies. It operates as a consolidator, folding independent agencies into a national platform.

cubecover.summary: CubeCover is a Nigerian insurtech that offers digital microinsurance products for affordable health and life cover to underserved populations.

geico.summary: GEICO is a US auto insurer that sells car, home, and other personal insurance directly to consumers online, by phone, and through mobile apps.

fitch.summary: Fitch is a credit rating agency that assesses the financial strength and creditworthiness of insurers, reinsurers, and other financial institutions.

american-growth-insurance.summary: American Growth Insurance is a US brokerage platform that acquires and consolidates independent insurance agencies using AI-driven operations. It applies AI tools across underwriting, servicing, and back-office functions.

pb-fintech.summary: PB Fintech is the Indian parent company of Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, operating online marketplaces for insurance and financial products.

klaimee.summary: Klaimee is an insurtech that provides insurance coverage for autonomous AI agents acting without human oversight. It covers losses caused by AI agent errors or unauthorized actions.

neodigital.summary: Neodigital is a German digital insurer selling personal lines coverage such as home, liability and legal protection directly online. Its insurance portfolio is being acquired by another German insurer as part of a wider digital-insurance consolidation.

cotality.summary: Cotality, formerly known as CoreLogic, is a property data and analytics provider serving the insurance and real estate industries. It supplies risk, underwriting and claims data used by insurers for property risk assessment.

federato.summary: Federato is a US insurtech that builds an AI-native underwriting platform for commercial insurance carriers. The platform helps underwriters prioritize submissions and manage risk appetite.

etiqa-insurance.summary: Etiqa Insurance is a Southeast Asian insurer jointly owned by Maybank and Ageas, selling life, general and takaful insurance. It operates across Singapore, Malaysia and other regional markets, often via bank branch partnerships.

simply-business.summary: Simply Business is an online insurance broker that sells small business coverage, including public liability, professional indemnity and cyber insurance. It matches customers with policies underwritten by a panel of insurance partners rather than underwriting risk itself.

sapiens.summary: Sapiens International is a software vendor that builds core insurance platforms for policy administration, claims and billing. Its software is used by property and casualty and life insurers worldwide.

oscar-health.summary: Oscar Health is a US health insurance company that sells individual and small-group health plans through a technology-driven platform. It also offers Medicare Advantage plans aimed at making health coverage easier to navigate online.

radian.summary: Radian is a US mortgage insurance company that provides private mortgage insurance and risk services to lenders. It has expanded into specialty property and casualty insurance through acquisitions of underwriting businesses.

nasdaq.summary: Nasdaq is a US stock exchange and financial technology company that operates equity and options markets and lists companies across many industries.

weecover.summary: Weecover is an insurtech that builds an embedded-insurance platform, giving banks and other partners an API to distribute and manage insurance products.

bmo-insurance.summary: BMO Insurance is the insurance arm of Bank of Montreal, offering life, health, dental and travel insurance products to bank customers. It has introduced AI-assisted tools to help advisors and clients select coverage faster.

insurity.summary: Insurity is a US insurance software vendor that provides core policy administration, claims, billing and analytics systems for property casualty insurers. Its customers include insurance carriers, MGAs and reinsurers that use its systems to run underwriting and claims operations.

dito-telecommunity.summary: DITO Telecommunity is a Philippine mobile network operator. It partners with insurtech companies to offer digital insurance products to its mobile subscribers.

eazy-digital.summary: Eazy Digital is a Thailand-based insurtech company. It was acquired by a regional insurtech group to expand digital insurance distribution in Thailand.

roadzen.summary: Roadzen is an AI-driven insurtech that builds software for auto and mobility insurers, covering telematics, underwriting, claims and roadside assistance. It also operates as a licensed managing general agent in the United States.

myka.summary: Myka is a Nigerian insurtech that sells accessible insurance products to underserved consumers. It aims to expand insurance coverage access across the country.

policyme.summary: PolicyMe is a Canadian insurtech that sells life insurance directly to consumers online. It aims to simplify the buying process and expand into other personal insurance products.

goosehead-insurance.summary: Goosehead Insurance is a US personal-lines insurance agency that sells home, auto and other policies through franchised and corporate agents. It uses proprietary technology to compare quotes across multiple carriers for clients.

feather.summary: Feather is a Germany-based insurtech that sells digital insurance policies tailored to expats living in Europe. Its offerings include international health and car insurance.

3if-ventures.summary: 3IF Ventures is a venture capital fund that invests in insurtech startups focused on expanding inclusive insurance access across Africa.

undp.summary: UNDP is the United Nations' development agency, which funds and runs programs supporting inclusive and climate insurance initiatives in emerging markets.

aggne-global.summary: Aggne Global is a US insurtech company that provides technology services to the insurance industry. It is majority owned by a global IT services company.

newrez.summary: Newrez is a US residential mortgage lender and servicer for homeowners nationwide. It partners with insurtech platforms to offer homeowners insurance comparison and quotes to its borrowers.

siriuspoint.summary: SiriusPoint is a Bermuda-based global insurer and reinsurer that underwrites specialty and property-casualty risk for commercial and consumer clients. It also partners with insurtech platforms to distribute niche coverage.

eyst.summary: EYST is a Tunisian insurtech that builds a digital platform for processing and speeding up insurance claims payouts. It targets insurers and policyholders in North Africa looking to digitize the claims process.

counterpart.summary: Counterpart is a managing general agent that underwrites management liability insurance, such as directors and officers coverage, for small and mid-sized businesses. It uses AI-driven underwriting and also offers coverage addressing risks created by AI systems.

andreessen-horowitz.summary: Andreessen Horowitz is a venture capital firm that invests in technology startups across many sectors. It is a frequent investor in fintech and insurtech companies at various funding stages.

cibc-innovation-banking.summary: CIBC Innovation Banking is the technology-focused lending arm of Canadian bank CIBC. It provides venture debt and growth financing to technology companies, including insurtechs.

carvana.summary: Carvana is an online marketplace for buying used cars, offering vehicle delivery and financing through its website and app. It has partnered with insurers to offer embedded auto insurance to its car buyers.

dxc.summary: DXC Technology is a global IT services company that serves insurers with software and business process outsourcing. Its offerings include policy administration and claims systems, plus a partner program connecting insurers with insurtech providers.

flora-fertility.summary: Flora Fertility is an insurtech that sells individually owned fertility insurance directly to consumers rather than through employer benefit plans. It aims to make fertility treatment coverage portable across jobs.

rosella.summary: Rosella is an insurtech that builds an AI platform automating commercial insurance brokerage tasks such as quoting and placement. It targets the US commercial insurance market.

delos.summary: Delos Insurance Solutions is an MGA that underwrites wildfire insurance coverage for homeowners in high-risk areas. It focuses on markets where standard carriers have pulled back from wildfire-exposed properties.

jazzcash.summary: JazzCash is a Pakistani mobile wallet and digital financial services provider. It partners with insurers to distribute health and life insurance products to its mobile app users.

trellis.summary: Trellis is an insurtech that operates an online marketplace where consumers compare and shop for car insurance quotes. Its technology has been integrated into a security software company's consumer product marketplace.

javln.summary: JAVLN is a New Zealand insurtech that provides cloud-based policy administration software to insurers and brokers. Its platform handles policy issuance and management for general insurance lines.

harper.summary: Harper is a Y Combinator-backed insurance brokerage that uses AI to automate commercial insurance placement for businesses.

equal-parts.summary: Equal Parts is an insurtech platform that pairs AI-driven tools with human insurance agents to serve independent insurance agencies and their clients.

intx.summary: INTX is an insurance technology company that builds a core software platform for insurers, covering policy administration and payment processing workflows.

goldman-sachs.summary: Goldman Sachs is a global investment bank and financial services firm that, alongside its core banking business, invests in and advises insurance and insurtech companies.

withcoverage.summary: WithCoverage is an insurtech company that offers an alternative to commission-based insurance brokers, helping businesses buy and manage commercial insurance.

kshema-general-insurance.summary: Kshema General Insurance is an Indian general insurer focused on agriculture and climate-risk insurance products for farmers and rural customers.

insuremo.summary: InsureMO is an insurance middleware and API platform that helps insurers and distributors launch and connect digital insurance products across Asia.

tide.summary: Tide is a UK business banking platform for small and medium-sized enterprises that also offers embedded insurance products alongside its core banking services.

prudential.summary: Prudential Financial is a US insurance and financial services company that provides life insurance, annuities, retirement and asset management products.

humana.summary: Humana is a US health insurance company that provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid and other health plans to individuals and employers.

cuvva.summary: Cuvva is a UK insurtech that sells flexible, short-term and pay-as-you-go car insurance through a mobile app.

ils-advisers.summary: ILS Advisers publishes independent research and performance indices tracking insurance-linked securities funds, which invest in catastrophe bonds and other reinsurance-linked instruments.

bima-sugam.summary: Bima Sugam is a state-backed digital insurance marketplace in India, intended to let consumers buy, renew and file claims on policies from multiple insurers through a single online platform.

mgt.summary: MGT is a US insurtech that uses AI to underwrite and price commercial property and casualty insurance for small businesses.

stand.summary: Stand is a US homeowners insurer that uses physics-based climate modeling and AI to underwrite coverage for properties exposed to wildfire and other climate risks that traditional insurers decline.

zego.summary: Zego is a UK insurtech that sells flexible, telematics-based commercial motor insurance to gig-economy drivers, couriers and vehicle fleets.

lightspun.summary: LightSpun is a US insurtech that builds AI-driven software for administering dental insurance plans, targeting insurers and benefits administrators.

palmpay.summary: PalmPay is a Nigerian mobile money and fintech app offering payments, transfers and savings, which distributes digital insurance products to its users through partnerships with insurers.

vouch.summary: Vouch is a US insurtech that provides business insurance tailored to startups and technology companies, originally as an MGA and increasingly through insurance broking.

quandri.summary: Quandri is a Canadian insurtech that builds AI software automating back-office tasks like policy renewals for insurance brokers and agencies across North America.

jupiter-money.summary: Jupiter Money is an Indian fintech app offering banking, savings and investment tools, which has expanded into distributing insurance products as a licensed broker.

galaxy-health-insurance.summary: Galaxy Health Insurance is an Indian standalone health insurer that sells individual and group medical cover, including wellness-linked and bancassurance products.

first-connect.summary: First Connect Insurance Services operates a network platform connecting independent insurance agents to a range of MGA and carrier products, expanding their access to specialty insurance lines.

tawuniya.summary: Tawuniya is a Saudi Arabian insurance company offering health, motor and other personal and commercial insurance products. It operates as one of the largest listed insurers in Saudi Arabia and has run innovation and startup-support initiatives in the region.

onsurity.summary: Onsurity is an Indian insurtech that sells subscription-based employee health and wellness benefits to small and mid-sized businesses. It bundles insurance, doctor consultations and health perks into a monthly plan employers offer their staff.

gxbank.summary: GXBank is a Malaysian digital bank backed by Grab that offers everyday banking services such as savings accounts and payments. It partners with insurers to distribute insurance products, including cyber and anti-scam cover, to its banking customers.

desaisiv.summary: DESAISIV is a startup that builds an AI-powered virtual insurance agent platform for insurers to automate customer and enterprise interactions. It is expanding the platform for enterprise insurance clients.

curant-ai.summary: Curant.ai is a startup that builds AI software to automate insurance claims processing for insurers and reinsurers. Its platform is used by carriers to speed up claims decisions in lines such as disability and life insurance.

axis-capital.summary: AXIS Capital is a Bermuda-based specialty insurer and reinsurer that underwrites commercial property, casualty and specialty risks globally. It operates through subsidiaries offering both primary insurance and reinsurance to corporate and institutional clients.

ciab.summary: CIAB, The Council of Insurance Agents & Brokers, is a US trade association representing commercial insurance and employee-benefits brokerage firms. It provides research, advocacy and professional development programs for its member firms.

gradient-ai.summary: Gradient AI is a technology vendor that builds AI-based decision-intelligence software for insurance carriers, underwriters, and claims teams.

mckenzie-intelligence-services.summary: McKenzie Intelligence Services is a UK geospatial intelligence firm that analyzes satellite imagery for catastrophe risk and event response. Its data helps insurers and reinsurers assess property damage and claims exposure after natural disasters.

relation-insurance-services.summary: Relation Insurance Services is a US insurance brokerage offering commercial, personal and employee-benefits coverage placement. It grows primarily by acquiring independent regional agencies and folding them into its national platform.

fenris.summary: Fenris is a technology vendor that supplies insurers with data and analytics APIs used for underwriting and instant, embedded insurance quoting.

mid-state-insurance.summary: Mid-State Insurance is an independent insurance agency in Wisconsin that sells commercial and personal coverage to local businesses and individuals.

slide.summary: Slide is a Florida-based, technology-enabled homeowners insurance company that underwrites property coverage directly to consumers.

oman-air.summary: Oman Air is the national airline of Oman, offering scheduled passenger and cargo flights connecting the Middle East to global destinations. It has begun embedding third-party travel insurance into its flight bookings.

soter-insure.summary: Soter Insure is an insurtech that arranges specialist insurance coverage for custodians, exchanges and other businesses in the digital asset sector.

leadway.summary: Leadway is a Nigerian insurance company that provides life, health, general and pension products to individuals and businesses across Nigeria.

friendsurance.summary: Friendsurance is a German insurtech that began as a peer-to-peer insurance broker. It now provides embedded insurance technology to banks and other partners across Europe.

munich-re.summary: Munich Re is a German reinsurer that provides reinsurance, primary insurance and risk-management services to insurers and corporations worldwide.

cinven.summary: Cinven is a European private equity firm that acquires and invests in companies across sectors including financial services and insurance.

la-caisse.summary: La Caisse is a Canadian pension and institutional investment fund that invests across public and private markets globally. It has taken stakes in specialty insurance underwriting platforms as part of its alternative investments.

optio.summary: Optio is a UK specialty insurance platform that underwrites and manages risk on behalf of third-party capacity providers. It operates across European specialty insurance markets.

vertafore.summary: Vertafore is a US insurance technology vendor that makes agency management and workflow software for insurance agents, brokers and MGAs. Its products include the BenefitPoint employee-benefits platform.

coalition.summary: Coalition is a US company that sells cyber insurance bundled with a cybersecurity risk-monitoring platform for small and midsize businesses. It also underwrites cyber coverage directly as an insurer.

philfirst.summary: PhilFirst is a Philippine insurance company that sells life and non-life coverage to Filipino consumers. It is expanding into AI-powered digital insurance products with technology partners.

hutch-enterprise.summary: HUTCH Enterprise is the business technology arm of Hutch, a Sri Lankan telecom operator, building digital platforms for local industries. It powers a nationwide digital vehicle-insurance verification system used by insurers and regulators.

moneysupermarket.summary: MoneySuperMarket is a UK price-comparison website where consumers compare insurance, utilities and other household bills. It is launching its own car insurance broking service alongside its comparison listings.

adam-riese.summary: Adam Riese is a German direct motor insurer that sells car and other personal-lines insurance online without traditional agents.

hsbc-life-singapore.summary: HSBC Life Singapore is a composite insurer in Singapore that sells life, health and wealth-related insurance to individuals and businesses. It was previously a subsidiary of HSBC Holdings.

lexisnexis-risk-solutions.summary: LexisNexis Risk Solutions is a US technology vendor that provides risk-assessment and identity-verification data tools to insurers. It also serves financial services, healthcare and public-sector clients with similar data and analytics products.

crc.summary: CRC is a wholesale insurance broker that helps retail agents place specialty and hard-to-place commercial risks with underwriters.

axa-xl.summary: AXA XL is the specialty property and casualty division of AXA Group. It underwrites complex commercial insurance and reinsurance risks for large and mid-sized businesses worldwide.

mylo.summary: Mylo is a digital insurance brokerage that helps small businesses and individuals compare and buy business insurance policies online. It focuses on coverage such as general liability and workers' compensation.

igms.summary: iGMS is a software platform that helps short-term rental hosts manage bookings, guest communication and operations across listing sites.

safely.summary: Safely provides guest screening, damage protection and insurance services for short-term rental hosts and property managers.

adclear.summary: Adclear is an AI-driven compliance platform that helps financial services firms monitor marketing communications for regulatory compliance. It supports adherence to rules such as the UK's Consumer Duty regime.

tokio-marine-hcc.summary: Tokio Marine HCC is a specialty insurance group that underwrites commercial and professional lines including cyber, marine and property risks. It operates through offices across the Americas, Europe and Asia.

techcombank.summary: Techcombank is a Vietnamese commercial bank offering retail and corporate banking services. It also distributes life and non-life insurance products through bancassurance partnerships.

shopeepay.summary: ShopeePay is a digital wallet and payments platform operated by Sea Group that lets users in Southeast Asia pay for purchases and top up accounts. It also distributes financial products including insurance through partner providers.

prudential-singapore.summary: Prudential Singapore is the Singapore life insurance arm of Prudential plc, selling life, health and investment-linked insurance products.

gate-insure.summary: Gate Insure is a UK-based digital motor insurance provider that offers online car insurance policies tailored to individual drivers.

cno-financial.summary: CNO Financial Group is a US insurance holding company that sells life, health, and annuity products to middle-income consumers. It operates through several branded subsidiaries serving that market segment.

horace-mann-educators.summary: Horace Mann Educators is a US insurer that sells auto, home, life and retirement products to teachers and school employees. It markets mainly through school-based representatives and payroll-deduction plans.

manger-insurance.summary: Manger Insurance is a North Dakota independent insurance agency that serves commercial, personal lines and employee-benefits clients, including a heavy oil and gas book of business.

hadron.summary: Hadron is an insurance carrier group that operates admitted, excess and surplus, and UK insurance carriers.

aspire-general.summary: Aspire General is a US insurance carrier that writes non-standard personal auto coverage. It has invested early in claims-automation technology to scale its claims operations.

kyber.summary: Kyber is a technology vendor that builds claims-automation software for insurance carriers. Its platform helps carriers speed up claims handling and reduce manual processing.

am-best.summary: AM Best is a credit rating agency focused on the insurance industry, assessing the financial strength of insurers and reinsurers.

neam.summary: NEAM is an investment management firm that manages investment portfolios for insurance and reinsurance companies. Its full name is New England Asset Management.

zhongan-online.summary: ZhongAn Online is a Chinese online-only insurer selling property, health, and lifestyle insurance digitally through web and mobile channels. It also licenses its underwriting and risk-technology platform to other insurers and partners.

nfp.summary: NFP is a US insurance broker and consulting firm serving businesses and individuals across property and casualty, benefits, and wealth management.

centene.summary: Centene is a US managed care company that provides government-sponsored health insurance, primarily Medicaid, Medicare, and ACA marketplace plans.

seventeen-group.summary: Seventeen Group is a UK-based insurance broking group that grows by acquiring independent brokers and bringing them under a shared ownership structure.

senate-insurance-brokers.summary: Senate Insurance Brokers is an insurance broker based in Gibraltar, a jurisdiction that underwrites a large share of UK motor insurance risk.

flexible-finance.summary: Flexible Finance, trading as Flex, is a financial technology company that lets tenants pay rent in installments through its Flex Rent product.

mercury.summary: Mercury is a California-founded insurance company that sells personal auto and home insurance directly and through independent agents.

enterprise-risk-associates.summary: Enterprise Risk Associates is an insurance brokerage that grows by acquiring independent agencies across the United States.

katrisk.summary: KatRisk builds catastrophe risk models covering perils such as flood, wind and earthquake, providing analytics used by insurers and reinsurers to price and manage exposure.

scale-ai.summary: Scale AI is a technology company that provides data labeling and training-data infrastructure for building and evaluating AI models across industries.

ebrd.summary: The EBRD is a multilateral development bank that finances and invests in businesses across emerging European, Central Asian and North African economies.

leadway-assurance.summary: Leadway Assurance is a Nigerian insurance company offering life, general and health insurance products to individuals and businesses.

nauto.summary: Nauto develops AI-powered dashcam and fleet safety technology that monitors driver behavior to reduce commercial fleet risk, used by insurers for telematics-based risk assessment.

fletch.summary: Fletch is a pet insurance comparison platform that helps pet owners compare policies from different insurers. It offers a shopping tool that runs inside ChatGPT to match users with providers based on their pet's needs.

igp-specialty.summary: IGP Specialty is a US-based specialty insurance company operating as Innovation Growth Partners Specialty, a subsidiary of USI Insurance Services. It underwrites specialty program business through a dedicated Programs Division.

fuse.summary: Fuse is a technology vendor that provides real-time market intelligence and data analytics to the commercial insurance industry. It organizes its offering into vertical-specific modules covering distinct classes of business, including healthcare and senior living liability.

pinion-insurance.summary: Pinion Insurance is a technology-enabled specialty insurer that builds proprietary data platforms for managing general agents. Its Sarrus platform provides a unified data interchange to replace fragmented manual data exchange between MGAs and carriers.

cincinnati-insurance.summary: Cincinnati Insurance is a US property-casualty insurer that sells commercial and personal lines coverage through independent agents. It is automating manual data entry processes as part of a broader push to modernize its underwriting operations.

price-forbes.summary: Price Forbes is a specialist insurance and reinsurance broker that arranges cover for complex commercial and casualty risks. It operates cross-class facilities, such as its Lectio follow facility, that let underwriters access multiple lines through a single placement.

pen-underwriting.summary: Pen Underwriting is a UK managing general agent that designs and underwrites specialist commercial insurance programs on behalf of insurers. It operates across lines including construction, casualty and property through a network of regional underwriting teams.

baptist-insurance.summary: Baptist Insurance is a UK insurer that provides property and liability cover tailored to churches, charities and faith-based organizations.

navacord.summary: Navacord is a Canadian insurance brokerage network that acquires and partners with independent brokerages across Canada. Partner firms become Navacord shareholders as part of its consolidation model.

revolut.summary: Revolut is a fintech company that offers a mobile banking app with multi-currency accounts, payment cards, and other financial services.

francisco-partners.summary: Francisco Partners is a private equity firm that invests in technology companies, including software and fintech businesses.

carolina-casualty.summary: Carolina Casualty is a US specialty insurer, operating as a subsidiary of W.R. Berkley Corporation, that underwrites commercial casualty coverage.

hudson-insurance.summary: Hudson Insurance is a U.S. specialty insurer that underwrites commercial property, casualty and other niche commercial coverages. It operates as the insurance subsidiary of Odyssey Group Holdings.

aeolus.summary: Aeolus is an investment manager focused on reinsurance and retrocession risk. It invests institutional capital in property catastrophe reinsurance and retrocession contracts written for insurers and reinsurers.

universal-insurance-holdings.summary: Universal Insurance Holdings is a U.S. property insurance holding company that underwrites homeowners coverage. It operates primarily in Florida along with several other U.S. states.

mandarin-re.summary: Mandarin Re is a Malaysia-based reinsurance company that provides reinsurance capacity to insurers in the region.

google-cloud.summary: Google Cloud is the cloud computing and AI platform division of Google. It provides infrastructure, data analytics and AI tools that insurers use to build automation and knowledge-management systems.

new-york-life.summary: New York Life is a U.S. life insurance company that sells life insurance, annuities and long-term care products directly and through agents.

rachas-group.summary: Árachas Group is an Irish insurance broker that arranges commercial and personal lines cover for businesses and individuals. It has expanded through acquisitions of smaller local insurance agencies.

autonomous.summary: Autonomous is an independent research firm covering financial sectors for institutional investors. It publishes analysis and commentary on insurance and reinsurance markets, among other sectors.

namic.summary: NAMIC is a U.S. trade association representing mutual insurance companies, advocating on regulatory and legislative issues on their behalf.

wcirb.summary: WCIRB is the statistical and rating organization for California's workers' compensation insurance market, supplying pricing data and research used by insurers and regulators.

aipso.summary: AIPSO is a US industry body that administers auto insurance assigned-risk plans for high-risk drivers insurers decline to cover.

hsbc.summary: HSBC is a global bank offering retail, commercial and investment banking, along with wealth and insurance distribution services worldwide.

canopius.summary: Canopius is a specialty insurance and reinsurance group that underwrites through Lloyd's of London and international platforms.

funding-societies.summary: Funding Societies is a Southeast Asian digital lending platform that provides SME financing across the region. It also bundles insurance coverage alongside its business loans.

questgates.summary: QuestGates is a UK loss adjusting and claims management firm that handles liability, property and specialist insurance claims for insurers and businesses.

howell-wild.summary: Howell Wild is a UK liability claims adjusting firm that handles liability insurance claims on behalf of insurers.

informdata.summary: InformData is a technology vendor that supplies verified people and employment data for use in insurance and business workflows.

speedbuilder-systems.summary: SpeedBuilder Systems is a technology vendor that builds document automation software for insurers, including tools for generating policy forms and other insurance paperwork.

doma.summary: Doma is a US real estate technology company that provides title insurance and closing services, using automation and data analytics to streamline home closings.

coverwatch.summary: Coverwatch is an insurtech developing an AI-driven insurance broker that helps customers shop for and manage policies.

scor.summary: SCOR is a French reinsurer that provides life, property and casualty reinsurance to insurance companies worldwide.

oakbridge-insurance-agency.summary: Oakbridge Insurance Agency is a US insurance brokerage that grows by acquiring independent regional agencies and adding them to its platform.

west-p-and-i.summary: West P&I is a marine protection and indemnity (P&I) club providing liability cover to shipowners and operators.

s-and-p-global.summary: S&P Global is a financial information and analytics company that provides credit ratings and market intelligence. Its ratings cover insurers and reinsurers across the industry.

mulberry.summary: Mulberry is a US insurtech that provides embedded product protection and extended warranty plans retailers offer customers at checkout.

arma-karma.summary: Arma Karma is a UK insurtech that sells flexible, on-demand insurance, including renters and gig-economy cover, through a mobile app.

clyde-and.summary: Clyde & Co is an international law firm that advises insurers, reinsurers and brokers on insurance, risk and dispute matters.

w-and-w-group.summary: W&W Group is a German financial services group that combines insurance and building-society banking products for retail customers.

aba-bank.summary: ABA Bank is a commercial bank in Cambodia that distributes insurance products through partner insurers as part of its retail banking services.

personal-group.summary: Personal Group is a UK company that sells employee benefits and insurance products, including health cash plans, to employers for their workforces.

singtel.summary: Singtel is a Singaporean telecommunications company offering mobile, broadband and enterprise services, and holds a stake in the regional insurer Etiqa.

talanx.summary: Talanx is a German insurance group and the parent company of HDI, offering life, property and casualty insurance and reinsurance across Europe and internationally.

homesite.summary: Homesite Insurance is a US home insurer, owned by American Family Insurance, that sells homeowners, renters and other property coverage directly and through partner channels.

united.summary: United Airlines is a major US airline operating domestic and international passenger and cargo flights from hubs across the country.

crowdstrike.summary: CrowdStrike is a US cybersecurity company that provides cloud-based endpoint protection and threat-detection software to businesses.

blue-marble.summary: Blue Marble Microinsurance is a consortium that designs and distributes parametric and microinsurance products for underserved markets in developing countries.

loadsure.summary: Loadsure is a US insurtech that provides on-demand and embedded cargo insurance for freight brokers, carriers and shippers.

crosscountry-freight-solutions.summary: CrossCountry Freight Solutions is a less-than-truckload freight carrier that transports shipments for businesses across the United States.

carpe.summary: Carpe is a technology vendor that builds AI-based claims processing software for property and casualty insurers.

nicb.summary: NICB, the National Insurance Crime Bureau, is a US nonprofit that partners with insurers and law enforcement to prevent, detect and investigate insurance fraud and vehicle theft.
